column2: We can remove this country from our ?Ysphere of influence?!

According to legend, Emperor Jimmu founded Japan in 660 BC, and the imperial bloodline has remained unbroken ever since. During the Edo period, the imperial family was still held in high esteem but had no real power. By restoring imperial authority and pursuing rapid industrialization, constitutionalism, and economic liberalism, Japan can shatter the shackles imposed upon her by the Western world!
